name: Deliver EZ
description: Smart Community Logistics Center — simple, flexible and secure control of online purchase logistics 24/7. Consolidates retailer, carrier, and shipping information so residents control how, when, and where packages are delivered.
industry: Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage
notes: Nav items confirmed via Playwright test run (from page snapshot). Contact page at /news/contact/ is a contact-info page (team mailto links, no HTML form) — hasContactForm is false. Site uses http:// nav hrefs that 307-redirect to https:// — this is expected and treated as ok by the link checker. Homepage has a 3-column comparison table that causes horizontal overflow at mobile/tablet viewports — known site bug tracked as test.fixme in layout.spec.ts.
